hook.name: FlywheelV4Hook
hook.description: Buyback-and-burn hook for a single ETH/token pool. Collects 0.7% fee on ETH buys into a burn pot and queues 0.7% of tokens on sells for burning. Sets a buyback-queued flag every 20 swaps; the buyback-and-burn swap is executed by calling flyWheel() externally. Blocks sells in the same block as a buyback. Restricts pool liquidity to a single initial add only.
